articles.title: The Associated Pressed Vault Hits 50-Article Day, Immediately Plans Tomorrow

articles.title: Postal Service Tests Delivery by 'When We Get There

articles.title: Man Discovers Gym Membership Works Better as Guilt Subscription

articles.title: Solar Eclipse Viewing Party Moved to Group Chat
articles.dek: Organizers cite 'better attendance when nobody has to drive.

articles.title: College Adds Major in Explaining Memes to Parents
articles.dek: Degree track covers tone, context, and when not to show them anything.

articles.dek: Spot attends blazes solely to look concerned and accept pets from bystanders.

articles.title: Wedding Industry Introduces Micro-Regret Packages

articles.title: Tech CEO Apologizes for Calling Everything 'AI' When It's Just Math
articles.dek: Statement promises future products will be 'at least partially real.

articles.title: Grocery Store Introduces Slow Lane for People Who Need a Minute
articles.dek: Aisle allows existential pause without judgment or someone sighing behind you.

articles.dek: Biscuit campaigned on belly rubs, fiscal responsibility, and not eating the minutes.

articles.title: Nation Exhausted After Short Week Somehow Feels Longer
articles.dek: Calendars lie, say workers who used holiday to catch up on work they avoided.

articles.title: Study Finds Average Meeting Could Have Been Email and Also Wasn't
articles.dek: Researchers describe paradox as 'the Schrödinger stand-up.

articles.title: Neighbors Form Coalition Against Guy Who Blows Leaves at 7 a.m.
articles.dek: Group seeks 'leaf diplomacy' after third weekend of turbine-based awakening.

articles.title: Economists Declare Soft Landing Has Been Replaced by Soft Ambivalence
articles.dek: Markets rise, fall, and then check phone for other news.

articles.title: Pentagon Confirms Area 51 Contains Mostly Unread Emails

articles.title: City Installs Crosswalk Button That Only Pretends to Work
articles.dek: Transportation officials say illusion of control reduces jaywalking and 'general civic screaming.

articles.title: CDC Issues Guidance on Touching Grass Safely

articles.title: Museum Opens Exhibit on Passwords You Will Never Remember

articles.dek: Employees encouraged to schedule tantrums between 2 and 2:15 p.m. near the wellness room.

articles.title: Library Introduces 'Screaming Allowed' Study Room

articles.title: Weather Service Adds 'Existential Drizzle' to Forecast
articles.dek: New category describes light rain that makes you question career choices without ruining shoes.

articles.title: School District Replaces Detention With Mandatory Podcast Listening
